tau_definition: 95th percentile of leave-one-episode-out nearest-neighbour distance over the MOVING pre-grasp frames (arm motion onset .. first close) of the 50 expert demos, matched against pre-grasp frames of the other 49 demos; 5 arm joints divided by their expert std. tau_sensitivity = same percentile over all pre-grasp frames incl. idle start.
gripper_open_value_definition: median gripper reading over the open plateau (>= 44) of the 50 expert demos
start_pose_definition: per-joint median of the 5 arm joints over the idle frames before the arm-motion onset, all 50 expert demos
units_note: not read from the recording configuration; inferred: LeRobot SOFollowerConfig.use_degrees default True (arm joints in degrees, gripper 0-100)
